### Full product description

The DEWALT DCB184 18V 5Ah XR Li-Ion Battery will deliver a distinctly impressive 66 percent longer runtime than a normal/standard 3.0Ah battery pack. This means you can complete jobs quicker and more easily thanks to less time spent charging or changing batteries. The DCB184 has an LED state of charge indicator so you can manage your charging quickly and easily. It is lightweight and its design gives you an upgraded 5Ah while not compromising on size or weight.

This battery has no memory effect and virtually no self-discharge, this means maximum productivity and minimum downtime. Handily, it is compatible with all DEWALT XR Li-Ion 18V Tools and is protected against overheating, overload and deep discharge, increasing your battery's life.

### Technical specification

Type Battery
Volts 18V
Amp hours 5.0Ah
Chemistry Li-Ion
Packaged Weight 2kg
Please note that details and specifications contained herein, are correct at the time of publishing. We reserve the right to change specifications at any time without prior notice.
